title: MV How to do I do a masking layer effect? (+ visual rendition)

posts.author: seachromo
posts.body:
Hello!
I’m trying to make a game and I’m thinking of maybe buying RPGMaker MV to do so. But first, I have to know if it possible to create the effect I’m looking for in this version.
I want to create an effect around the playable character, which is basically a masking effect. As they walk and interact, there’s a pixelated circle (that represents their vision) around them. Inside their circle, there will be a more detailed view of the scenes. While as on the outside the circle, it will be loose drawings so you still know the surroundings but will have to get closer to interact and see objects. I’m thinking of doing so with 2 map layers (maybe that’s not possible) or maybe one map (bottom layer) and an image on top. Also, I wanted the circle to shrink / grow in size throughout the game so that the player will have to collect specific items in the game to maintain its size (kind of like a flashlight with its batteries). Also maybe with a sliding bar to show how much of their vision is left.
Is this possible? If so, how do I do it or do you know of any resources that can help? I’m new to this so anything helps ^^
I attached a simple rendition of what I’m trying to achieve in Procreate but I can’t seem to be able to attach videos so here’s a screenshot of it lmao in case my explanation wasn’t good enough.
Have a good day!
